title: TrueType, Font
documentation:
## File type
The concrete file format. Each value identifies a single, well-known format with its
file extensions and MIME type. File-type is the identity-tag of file-format media URNs:
`media:pdf` carries the pdf file-type marker, `media:json;textable;record` carries the
json file-type marker.

The file-type dim is authored across multiple fragment files in `fabric/dims/file-type/`
grouped by category (image, audio, video, archive, document, source, font, model,
data, config, web, other). Fragment merging produces a single global file-type dim
catalogue.

TrueType font. Outline-font format originally developed by Apple.

## Medium
Medium tags declare the primary human-perceivable nature of a value: visual, audible,
textual, etc. Medium is what a person experiences when consuming the value. Some media
types carry multiple media tags (a PDF is both visual when displayed and textable when
its text layer is extracted).

Medium should not be confused with coercion: `textable` (coercion) means "can be
encoded as UTF-8 text without loss"; `textual` (medium) means "is fundamentally text
to a human reader." A JSON config is textable but not necessarily textual in this
sense — it is structured data that happens to be text-encoded.

The value is a font file (ttf, otf, woff, woff2). Caps for font inspection or
rendering match on this tag.
